description: Look up an IP address in the Shodan InternetDB. Returns open ports, hostnames, known vulnerabilities (CVEs), CPEs (software identifiers), and tags. Free, no API key needed. Example: lookup_ip("8.8.8.8").
name: lookup_ip

cpes.description: List of CPE software identifiers found on the IP address

found.description: Whether the IP address was found in Shodan InternetDB

hostnames.description: List of hostnames associated with the IP address

ip.description: The IPv4 address that was looked up

ports.description: List of open ports found on the IP address

tags.description: List of tags associated with the IP address

vulns.description: List of known CVE vulnerabilities for the IP address

title: Lookup Ip
